- [`resolve_pairwise_user_id`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/pairwise.py) — Function. Resolve the active Reactor store and return its stable pairwise ID.
- [`ResolvingTransport`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. Every request to an untrusted host resolved, vetted, and pinned.
- [`RETRY_POLICIES`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Constant. Public `RETRY_POLICIES` constant.
- [`RetryPolicy`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. When to retry a refused request (Guides, retries).
- [`RevocationResult`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/accounts.py) — Class. A revocation the company acknowledged; the local copy is gone.
- [`RsaBlindSigningKey`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/blind.py) — Class. A reference `BlindSigningKey`: an RSA key of 2048 bits or more (3072 suggested).
- [`ScopeHint`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/models.py) — Class. What a scope allows, its most consequential operation (§4.4): a Company's claim.
- [`ServiceTokens`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/accounts.py) — Class. The access tokens of one account, one per service that asks for its own (§4.5).
- [`SESSION_SIGNERS`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Constant. Public `SESSION_SIGNERS` constant.
- [`SessionClient`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/sessions.py) — Class. Start Sessions, and send grants to the company's token endpoint (§4, §5).
- [`SessionError`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/errors.py) — Class. A session request failed without exposing response secrets.
- [`SessionHttpClient`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/transport.py) — Class. Send requests with the Session header; a redirect is refused, never followed (§3).
- [`SessionJwtRequest`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. What one Session JWT is signed for (§5.2): a request, its Session, its User.
- [`SessionSigner`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. Sign the Session JWT of one request with a delegated key (§5.2).
- [`SharedRateLimitBudget`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. Default `pap.rateLimitBudget`: per-company budgets in one process.
- [`Signer`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. Sign a compact assertion without exposing private key material.
- [`SIGNERS`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Constant. Public `SIGNERS` constant.
- [`SignInResult`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/sessions.py) — Class. A completed sign-in (§4.7): the access token, and the refresh token's reference.
- [`SignOutResult`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/accounts.py) — Class. Sign-out (§5.5): how many refresh tokens were revoked, and whether all were.
- [`SqlitePairwiseUserIdStore`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/pairwise.py) — Class. Atomically persist random pairwise IDs in a local SQLite database.
- [`stale_resource_metadata`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/accounts.py) — Function. Whether a service refused a token not issued for it (§4.5).

- [`StreamReconnected`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/conversations.py) — Class. The stream was reopened from `Last-Event-ID`.
- [`SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/models.py) — Constant. Public `SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS` constant.
- [`SystemClock`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. Default UTC wall clock.
- [`SystemRandomSource`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. Default operating-system cryptographic randomness.

- [`TELEMETRY_EVENTS`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/telemetry.py) — Constant. Public `TELEMETRY_EVENTS` constant.
- [`TELEMETRY_SINKS`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Constant. Public `TELEMETRY_SINKS` constant.
- [`TelemetryEvent`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/telemetry.py) — Class. One finished protocol stage: a span for traces, an event for analytics.
- [`TelemetrySink`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Class. Receive each finished protocol stage (`telemetry.TelemetryEvent`), redacted already.

- [`TextDelta`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/conversations.py) — Class. A piece of a message still being written (SSE `text-delta`, §7.6).

- [`TokenResponse`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/sessions.py) — Class. A token endpoint's answer, as on the wire (§4.7): plain OAuth.

- [`TransportError`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/errors.py) — Class. An authenticated PAP resource request failed safely.
- [`URL_SAFETY_POLICIES`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/personal_agent_protocol/reactor.py) — Constant. Public `URL_SAFETY_POLICIES` constant.
